content.summary: Singular Genomics (OMIC) Systems announced that it has entered into a definitive merger agreement whereby an affiliate of Deerfield Management Company, will acquire Singular Genomics in an all-cash transaction for $20.00 per share. The $20.00 per share represents 254% premium to the last closing share price for Singular’s common stock prior to the September 12, 2024 public disclosure of Deerfield’s initial acquisition proposal.
